candidates.title: ChainlinkAdapter ignores answeredInRound + Chainlink min/maxAnswer circuit-breaker bounds
candidates.description: price() uses only answer+updatedAt; no answeredInRound>=roundId and no min/maxAnswer bound check. A frozen-at-bound price is accepted within PriceOracle staleness (which only checks updatedAt).

candidates.title: PriceOracle unconfigured staleness (0) forces every primary price stale -> silent backup routing
candidates.description: staleness unset (0) => any lastUpdated<now is stale => primary discarded, backup (or revert) used.

candidates.title: Permissionless rate poke compounds the interest multiplier per-call (timing-gameable)
candidates.description: RateOracle._getRate uses .call (not staticcall) to VaultAdapter.rate which MUTATES utilizationData.multiplier per invocation as a function of elapsed; poke frequency/timing changes the accrued rate-multiplier (compounding granularity).

candidates.title: Single-asset cap mint/burn priced per-asset -> cross-asset oracle-drift / depeg basket arbitrage
candidates.description: mint/burn value each basket asset independently at oracle prices; single-asset mint+burn let a user pick the asset; fee slopes penalize only basket ratio, not divergence between two assets' oracle prices. If one basket asset depegs or its oracle drifts, mint cheap / burn dear drains backing. Contingent on oracle accuracy (cf C-01).

candidates.title: FractionalReserve realizeInterest rounding can dip into principal-backing shares
candidates.description: withdraw(claimableInterest) burns previewWithdraw (rounds UP) vs claimableInterest convertToAssets (rounds DOWN); repeated realize can erode principal backing. NatSpec acknowledges dust. Likely Low.

candidates.title: Deeply-underwater agents give zero liquidation bonus + liquidatedValue capped at slashable -> liquidator under-compensated -> bad debt
candidates.description: bonus() returns 0 when totalDelegation<=totalDebt; liquidatedValue is capped at totalSlashableCollateral while the liquidator still repays `liquidated` debt. For deeply underwater agents the liquidator receives less value than they repay -> no incentive -> bad debt accrues. (Already-covered class from revert-lend M-24.)

candidates.title: Liquidation slashes against PAST-epoch slashable collateral; restaker collateral reduced since slashTimestamp can under-slash the liquidator
candidates.description: slash uses networkSlashableCollateral at slashTimestamp = max((epoch-1)*dur, lastBorrow); slashShare = amount/pastCollateral applied by the middleware. If restaker collateral decreased between the checkpoint and the slash, actual slashed value < liquidatedValue -> liquidator under-paid / backing overstated. VERIFY in SymbioticNetworkMiddleware (whether slash applies share to current vs past collateral).
